text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I ran into 
Hishi Amazon, groaning with her head in 
her hands.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Aaah, ouch, ouch, ouch! My head is 
pounding...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Damn it...! Big Sis Hishi Ama ain't gonna 
lose to a measly headach—ow, ow, ow, ow, 
ow!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's you, Trainy... Don't worry, it's 
not a big deal.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe because I used my brain too much, I 
have a bit of a headache...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"No, I was just reading a recipe book. 
It's the one my father used back when he 
lived in America."

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
When I looked it up, the units were 
totally different from Japan's! Like, 
what's up with 1 pound being 453 grams?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
To top it off, the temperature's even 
written in Fahrenheit. And here I am, 
totally hopeless at math...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
"The photo in the book just looked so 
delicious! So I powered through all the 
annoying calculations and made it myself!"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Wait, uuuugh... Talking just made it hurt 
even more...!

And so, Hishi Amazon found herself plagued 
by a headache...
